items.title: AN ORDINANCE OF THE MAYOR AND THE CITY COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF MIAMI BEACH, FLORIDA, AMENDING CHAPTER 82 OF THE MIAMI BEACH CITY CODE ENTITLED “PUBLIC PROPERTY,” BY AMENDING ARTICLE V, ENTITLED “IN GENERAL,” BY AMENDING SECTION 82-441 THEREOF, ENTITLED “FISHING FROM VIADUCTS AND BRIDGES IN THE JETTY AREA BETWEEN 29TH AND 33RD STREETS AND IN RESTRICTED SWIM AREAS,” BY PROVIDING DEFINITIONS, AMENDING, AND CLARIFYING THOSE AREAS IN WHICH SALTWATER FISHING IS PROHIBITED FOR THE PROTECTION OF THE PUBLIC HEALTH, SAFETY, AND WELFARE; AND PROVIDING FOR REPEALER, SEVERABILITY, CODIFICATION, AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

AN ORDINANCE OF THE MAYOR AND CITY COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF MIAMI BEACH, FLORIDA, AMENDING CHAPTER 110 OF THE CODE OF THE CITY OF MIAMI BEACH, ENTITLED “UTILITIES,” BY AMENDING ARTICLE IV, ENTITLED “FEES, CHARGES, RATES AND BILLING PROCEDURE,” SECTION 110-166 THEREOF, ENTITLED “SCHEDULE OF MONTHLY WATER USER RATES AND TAPPING CHARGES,” TO GRANT AUTHORITY TO THE CITY MANAGER OR THEIR DESIGNEE TO IMPLEMENT ADDITIONAL PASS-THROUGH ADJUSTMENTS TO WATER USER RATES UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES AND TO DETERMINE APPLICABLE WATER USER RATES; BY AMENDING SECTION 110-168 THEREOF, ENTITLED “SCHEDULE OF MONTHLY SANITARY SEWER USER RATES,” TO GRANT AUTHORITY TO THE CITY MANAGER OR THEIR DESIGNEE TO IMPLEMENT ADDITIONAL PASS-THROUGH ADJUSTMENTS TO SANITARY SEWER USER RATES UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES AND TO DETERMINE APPLICABLE SANITARY SEWER USER RATES; AND FURTHER, BY AMENDING APPENDIX A TO THE CITY CODE, ENTITLED “FEE SCHEDULE,” TO INCREASE WATER RATES, SANITARY SEWER SERVICE CHARGES, AND STORMWATER FEES TO FUND THE CITY’S REVISED CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PLAN FOR WATER, SEWER, AND STORMWATER PROJECTS PREPARED PURSUANT TO RESOLUTION NO. 2026-34383; AND PROVIDING FOR CODIFICATION, REPEALER, SEVERABILITY, AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

ALTON CITY CENTER OVERLAY – COMPREHENSIVE PLAN AMENDMENT AN ORDINANCE OF THE MAYOR AND CITY COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF MIAMI BEACH, FLORIDA, AMENDING THE CITY OF MIAMI BEACH YEAR 2050 COMPREHENSIVE PLAN PURSUANT TO THE SMALL SCALE AMENDMENT REVIEW PROCESS OF SECTION 163.3187(1), FLORIDA STATUTES, TO CREATE THE "ALTON CITY CENTER OVERLAY DISTRICT" BY AMENDING THE "RESILIENT LAND USE & DEVELOPMENT ELEMENT," GOAL RLU 1, ENTITLED "LAND USE," OBJECTIVE RLU 1.1, ENTITLED "ESTABLISHMENT OF FUTURE LAND USE CATEGORIES," TABLE RLU 1.1, TO MODIFY THE FLOOR AREA RATIO (FAR) AND DENSITY REGULATIONS FOR CONSISTENCY WITH THE LAND DEVELOPMENT REGULATIONS; BY AMENDING POLICY RLU 1.1.9, ENTITLED "MEDIUM INTENSITY COMMERCIAL (CD-2)," TO CREATE FAR AND DENSITY INCENTIVES TO ENCOURAGE REDEVELOPMENT OF DORMANT COMMERCIAL PARCELS INTO MIXED-USE PROJECTS ON PROPERTIES THAT MEET CERTAIN REQUIREMENTS AND ARE LOCATED IN THE "ALTON CITY CENTER OVERLAY DISTRICT"; BY AMENDING THE FUTURE LAND USE MAP TO INCLUDE THE "ALTON CITY CENTER OVERLAY DISTRICT" IN THE AREA LOCATED BETWEEN THE WEST SIDE OF ALTON ROAD AND THE EAST SIDE OF WEST AVENUE BETWEEN LINCOLN ROAD AND 17TH STREET; AND PROVIDING FOR CODIFICATION, REPEALER, SEVERABILITY, TRANSMITTAL AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.
